# WinUtil — third-party tweak definitions

`tweaks.json` in this folder is a vendored copy of the tweak configuration from
**Chris Titus Tech's WinUtil**, used as the authoritative source for the
registry keys, service settings, and scripts that some of this app's tweaks are
adapted from.

- **Source:** https://github.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil — `config/tweaks.json`
- **Raw URL:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil/main/config/tweaks.json
- **Fetched:** 2026-09-16
- **License:** MIT

WinUtil is distributed under the MIT License. Tweaks in this app that are
adapted from it retain that provenance; the app credits WinUtil in its README.
This file is kept for attribution and so the exact upstream operations can be
referenced when maintaining the adapted tweaks. It is reference data only — the
app does not execute WinUtil's PowerShell at runtime.
